title: The batch runner's working state lives in one file on branch roadmap that it rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction
why: Owner 22:47 CST Nov 13 (relayed): the batch runner seemed to have amnesia after compaction. Third cause, by the consultant: its working state (merge queue order, train batches and members, gos, holds with their end events, archive pass) lives only in its handoff.
note: Triage 22:48 CST Nov 13: one file on branch roadmap (the wave plan or a sibling file) that the runner rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction; its handoff points to the file and never copies the list (handoff prompt step 4: "name the home and never copy the list"). Open problem, runner 10's own words earlier tonight (relayed): it cannot push to the record branch. Options for the lane to weigh: the runner sends the state to triage, who commits it (a per-merge message); or the runner is given push access to roadmap by its own grant. Neither is chosen. Not started; the coordinator assigns a lane. Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read first. Coordinator 22:59 CST (relayed): lane session_013NEJKzngb7eVxWuaoEuzrC started. Its pick for the push problem (coordinator's, not the owner's): no new grant; runner 10 sends its state to triage per merge and triage commits; schema and seed file in the lane's PR. The lane stops and reports if a past ruling contradicts it. Lane 00:33 CST Nov 14 (relayed; PR #3359 draft, head 9fc5e84f3a, lane lint PASS, review record done; record docs/decisions/runner-state-on-record.md; handed to runner 10, coordinator 23:36): TRIAGE DUTY after #3359 merges, with no seed commit. When runner 10 sends the first `RUNNER-STATE <owner/repo> v1 after merge #<PR>` and `git show origin/roadmap:plans/runner-state.json` fails (file absent): save the body to a file, run python3 skills/project-ops/scripts/check_runner_state.py message <file> --first, commit the body whole (no code fence) as plans/runner-state.json on roadmap, push, answer the runner with the commit. Each later message: git show origin/roadmap:plans/runner-state.json > <committed file>, then check_runner_state.py message <file> <committed file>; exit 0: commit, push, answer with the commit; a problem: commit nothing, send the runner the printed lines; exit 2 (unknown): commit nothing, tell the runner. The seed skills/project-ops/templates/runner-state.json is for reference only.
